_about: What Google shows for Meel's most-searched pages, written by hand in the words riders search (Search Console, the 28 days to 24 November 2026). Kept out of data/routes because those files are rebuilt by data/tools. `pnpm titles:check` fails when a number in a title or lead is not in the fact itself, so a changed fact forces its title to change too.

/routes/andhra-araku-gandikota.title: Vizag to Gandikota by bike via Araku: 928 km route guide

/routes/assam-kaziranga-majuli/rules/maj.title: Majuli ferry tickets: online or at the ghat counter
/routes/assam-kaziranga-majuli/rules/maj.lead: Book on the state ferry portal, which lists Nimati and Kamalabari and sells tickets in advance, or at the counter. Online tickets began at Nimati Ghat in 2021.

/routes/assam-kaziranga-majuli/rules/maj.title: Majuli ferry timings: 7:30 am to 3:30 pm from Nimati
/routes/assam-kaziranga-majuli/rules/maj.lead: Ferries from Nimati Ghat to Kamalabari or Aphalamukh run 7:30 am to 3:30 pm, says the district site. Book ahead; winter timings are shorter.

/routes/darcha-shinku-la-padum/rules/lah.title: e-Aagman pass for Lahaul–Spiti: bikes need one too
/routes/darcha-shinku-la-padum/rules/lah.lead: Every vehicle entering Lahaul and Spiti, motorcycles included, applies online: an e-permit for the Atal Tunnel–Chandratal circuit, an e-ticket elsewhere.

/routes/goa-gokarna-karnataka-coast/rule.title: Goa helmet rule: compulsory for rider and pillion
/routes/goa-gokarna-karnataka-coast/rule.lead: Both rider and pillion. Central law says anyone over four on a two-wheeler wears a helmet; Goa said in January 2026 it would enforce the pillion rule.

/routes/golden-quadrilateral/rules/ahmed.title: Bikes on Ahmedabad–Vadodara Expressway? No, ride NH 48
/routes/golden-quadrilateral/rules/ahmed.lead: No. Two-wheelers are barred; ride NH 48 via Nadiad and Anand instead.

/routes/golden-quadrilateral/rules/delhi.title: Bikes on Delhi–Mumbai Expressway? Not allowed
/routes/golden-quadrilateral/rules/delhi.lead: No. Motorcycles, scooters, three-wheelers and tractors are barred by gazette notice. Ride the old highway through Jaipur instead.

/routes/golden-quadrilateral/rules/mumba.title: Bikes on Mumbai–Pune Expressway? No, take old NH 48
/routes/golden-quadrilateral/rules/mumba.lead: No. Two-wheelers are barred, the new Missing Link included. Ride the old highway, NH 48, via Khopoli, Khandala and Lonavala.

/routes/konkan-coast/fuel/node-137862850.title: Malvan CNG pump: Bharat Petroleum, 29 km on the Goa road
/routes/konkan-coast/fuel/node-137862850.lead: Bharat Petroleum pump with petrol and CNG, 29 km after Malvan on the way to Panaji. Next pump 1 km on.

/routes/konkan-coast/rules/atal-setu-two.title: Are bikes allowed on Atal Setu? No, two-wheelers barred
/routes/konkan-coast/rules/atal-setu-two.lead: No. Two-wheelers, three-wheelers, cycles and animal carts may not enter the Sewri to Nhava Sheva sea link. Use another road or the ferry.

/routes/konkan-coast/rules/ferry-agardan.title: Agardanda–Dighi ferry timings: 8 am to 9 pm, hourly
/routes/konkan-coast/rules/ferry-agardan.lead: Boats about hourly: from Agardanda 8 am to 8.30 pm, from Dighi 8 am to 9 pm; two operators alternate. Motorcycles go with their rider.

/routes/konkan-coast/rules/ferry-dabhol-.title: Dabhol–Dhopave ferry timings: 6.30 am–10.10 pm, bikes go
/routes/konkan-coast/rules/ferry-dabhol-.lead: Boats about every 45 minutes: from Dabhol 6.30 am to 10 pm, from Dhopave 6.45 am to 10.10 pm. Motorcycles go with their rider.

/routes/konkan-coast/rules/ferry-tavsal-.title: Tavsal–Jaigad ferry timings: 6.40 am to 10 pm, bikes go
/routes/konkan-coast/rules/ferry-tavsal-.lead: Boats roughly hourly: from Tavsal 6.40 am to 9.40 pm, from Jaigad 7 am to 10 pm. Motorcycles go with their rider.

/routes/konkan-coast/rules/mumbai-coasta.title: Bikes on Mumbai Coastal Road? No, cars and buses only
/routes/konkan-coast/rules/mumbai-coasta.lead: No. Only cars and buses may use the Coastal Road from Marine Lines to Worli.

/routes/mussoorie-dhanaulti-chakrata/rul.title: Mussoorie Mall Road timings: no vehicles 4:30 to 10 pm
/routes/mussoorie-dhanaulti-chakrata/rul.lead: No vehicles on Mall Road from 4:30 pm to 10 pm, says an October 2026 report; earlier rules said from 5 pm. No bike exemption reported.

/routes/north-sikkim/rules/north-sikkim-.title: Toong (Tung) check post timing: cross by 4 pm
/routes/north-sikkim/rules/north-sikkim-.lead: Cross Toong (Tung) check post by 4 pm, going up and coming down, under a Mangan district order. Carry your permit.

/routes/north-sikkim/rules/sikkim-aadhaa.title: Sikkim permit: Aadhaar not accepted, carry voter ID
/routes/north-sikkim/rules/sikkim-aadhaa.lead: Aadhaar is not accepted for Protected Area Permits (Nathu La, Zuluk, North Sikkim). Bring a passport, voter ID or driving licence, and two photos.

/routes/rajasthan-desert/rules/bawliyanw.title: Tanot border pass: book online for Bawliyanwala
/routes/rajasthan-desert/rules/bawliyanw.lead: Every adult needs a pass, booked online on the Tanot temple trust website, to go past Tanot to the Bawliyanwala border point.

_primary_route_about: A rule repeated on several routes is one page to Google: the others name this route's page as the main one. Picked by which copy Google showed most in the 90 days to 24 November 2026; by hand where Google had shown none. A repeated rule missing here falls back to the first route in alphabetical order.
